description: Read your own isolated Untax test order. Requires owner:sandbox sign-in. Payment and draft delivery statuses are separate from production eligibility or county filing. Show the returned test checkout link when payment is pending. When an order_id is known, read the same order after checkout or an uncertain failure before retrying. If starting checkout fails before an order_id is returned, retry start_tax_sandbox with the original idempotency_key; do not create a new key for the same attempt. get_tax_sandbox_order and complete_tax_sandbox_order take only order_id. Report test payment, draft generation, download availability and external delivery as separate observed states. Do not claim the draft is available until the order confirms its artifact is available; a payment or download URL alone is not proof. A sandbox receipt or simulated submission is not county filing, external email delivery or permission for live payments.
name: get_tax_sandbox_order
